name: Carmi
overview: The name Carmi appears in Scripture as a significant patriarchal figure, notably as a son of Reuben, Israel's firstborn, and as the father of Achan from the tribe of Judah. Genesis 46:9 and Exodus 6:14 list Carmi among the sons of Reuben, highlighting his place in Israel's early family structure. Later, in Joshua 7, Carmi is identified as the father of Achan, whose disobedience in taking forbidden spoils brought God's judgment upon Israel, illustrating the serious consequences of sin within God's covenant community.
